name: self-starter
description: Define custom events in plain language and let Codex act when they happen, with no model tokens spent while waiting.

interface.shortDescription: Act on custom events you define
interface.longDescription: Describe what should count as an event and what Codex should do. Codex writes a probe for files, logs, commands, services or APIs; Self-Starter checks it without calling a model and brings the task back to your conversation when it fires.
interface.defaultPrompt: Watch something for me and act when it happens
